ChatLog.Name: Transactions in chat
ChatLog.Hint: Announce purchases, sales, gifts, exchanges and repayments in chat.

Currencies.Name: Currencies
Currencies.Label: Configure currencies
Currencies.Hint: Monetary systems, coins, exchange rates, money changer fee and link with the game system's sheet.

HistorySize.Name: History size
HistorySize.Hint: Number of transactions kept in the history (the oldest are removed). 0 = no history.

MerchantDoubleClick.Name: Double-click merchants
MerchantDoubleClick.Hint: Double-clicking a merchant's token opens their shop for players. The GM opens the sheet, or the shop with Alt + double-click.

MerchantRange.Name: Merchant range
MerchantRange.Hint: Maximum distance (grid units) between a character and the merchant's token to buy or sell. 0 = no limit.

HaggleFormula.Name: Haggle roll
HaggleFormula.Hint: Roll formula, using the character's data (e.g. 1d20 + @skills.per.total). Empty = Persuasion for dnd5e, 1d20 for other systems.

DueReminderDays.Name: Reminder before due date
DueReminderDays.Hint: Warn the parties of a debt this many days before it is due (world time). 0 = only when it is due.

OtiumHistory.Name: Otium orders in history
OtiumHistory.Hint: Record orders placed in Otium taverns in Mint's history.

Wallet.Title: Purse
Wallet.ExchangeHint: The money changer keeps a {fee}% fee.
Wallet.ExchangeAll: Leave the amount empty to exchange everything.

Shop.Title: Shops
Shop.SellHint: The merchant buys back at {ratio}% of their price.
Shop.HaggleHint: Try to talk the prices down (DC {dc})
Shop.HaggleDone: Already haggled here: wait for it to wear off

Editor.Title: Shop — {name}
Editor.Name: Name
Editor.MarkupHint: Markup (or discount if negative) applied to every price in the shop.
Editor.SellRatioHint: Share of the price the merchant pays when a player sells them an item.
Editor.ElasticityHint: Strength of supply and demand: 0.5 = the price rises 50% when stock is empty, and drops when stock is above normal.
Editor.FactorsHint: The price stays between these two multiples of the base price.
Editor.RestockHint: How often (world time, in hours) stock returns toward normal. 0 = manual restock.
Editor.TreasuryHint: Merchant's money to buy items back. Empty = unlimited.
Editor.DropHint: Drop an item here to add it.
Editor.Linked: Linked to an item: the buyer receives it (click to unlink)
Editor.TargetHint: Normal stock: below it the price rises, above it the price drops.
Editor.RestockAmountHint: Units returning (or selling off) toward normal each interval.
Editor.BuybackHint: The merchant buys this item back.
Editor.MerchantHint: Drop an actor or a token into this window to make them the merchant. Double-clicking their token opens the shop for players.
Editor.TillHint: What the merchant can pay when items are sold to them.
Editor.TillNoMerchant: Pick a merchant: their purse is the till.
Editor.HaggleDCHint: Result to reach on the haggle roll.
Editor.HaggleMaxHint: A success gives a 5% discount, plus 1% per point above the DC, up to this cap.
Editor.HagglePenaltyHint: Markup when the roll fails by 5 or more.
Editor.HaggleHoursHint: How long (world time) the result lasts before haggling again.
Editor.ReputationHint: Price adjustment for each character: −10 = 10% discount (and selling 10% higher), +20 = 20% more expensive.
Editor.RegionHint: Exchange region where the shop stands.
Editor.RegionHelp: Items linked to a good follow its price in this region: the base price changes daily with supply and demand.
Editor.GoodQty: Quantity of the good per item
Editor.MarketPrice: Follows the good's price in the shop's region.

Ledger.Title: Loans and debts
Ledger.ConfirmForgive: Forgive this debt? The debtor will owe nothing more.
Ledger.ConfirmCancel: Cancel this debt? No money is returned.
Ledger.TransferHint: Loan: the creditor pays the sum to the debtor as soon as the debt is accepted. Unchecked: a simple IOU.
Ledger.DueHint: Number of days (world time) to repay. 0 = no due date.

Currencies.Title: Currencies
Currencies.FeeHint: Percentage kept by the money changer when exchanging between monetary systems.
Currencies.SheetPathHint: Where linked coins are read on actor sheets. "auto" = system.currency for dnd5e, nothing for other systems. Empty: everything is stored by Mint.
Currencies.RateHint: Value of this system's smallest unit compared to other systems. E.g. 1 for the kingdom, 0.8 for a slightly weaker foreign currency.
Currencies.PrimaryHint: Used when an amount is typed without a unit, and to guess prices.
Currencies.Name: Name
Currencies.ValueHint: Value in the system's smallest units (the smallest coin is worth 1).
Currencies.SheetKeyHint: Sheet field to keep in sync (e.g. gp for dnd5e). Empty = stored by Mint.
Currencies.LastCurrency: A system keeps at least one coin.
Currencies.ConfirmRemoveSystem: Remove the {name} system and its coins? Those coins will no longer be shown.
Currencies.SmallestWarn: This system's smallest coin should be worth 1, otherwise change cannot always be given exactly.
Currencies.ConfirmPreset: Replace the whole currency configuration with this preset?
Currencies.DisplayHint: Coin used to write prices and amounts. Uncheck platinum and electrum to read "37 gp 7 cp" rather than "3 pp 1 ep 2 sp 7 cp". Purses always show every coin.

Notify.Proposal: {from} proposes a debt of {amount}: open Loans and debts to answer.
Notify.DueSoon: Due in {days} d: {debtor} still owes {amount} to {creditor}.
Notify.LoanRequest: {name} asks {bank} for a loan of {amount}: answer in Loans and debts.

Error.Unexpected: Mint: unexpected error (details in the console).
Error.NoGM: No GM connected: this action needs a GM.
Error.Timeout: The GM did not answer in time.
Error.ExchangeTooSmall: Amount too small for the money changer.
Error.CannotConsolidate: These coins can't be consolidated without loss.
Error.ShopBroke: {shop} only has {amount} left in the till.
Error.NoParty: One of the parties' names is missing.
Error.NotParty: You're not involved in this debt.
Error.NotPending: This proposal is no longer pending.
Error.NotActive: This debt is no longer ongoing.
Error.AlreadyHaggled: You already haggled at {shop}: come back later.
Error.NotPotOwner: Only the GM or whoever opened the pot can settle it.
Error.NoFloat: {faction} only has {left} shares left for sale.

Haggle.Offended: Haggling at {shop}: the merchant is offended, +{pct}% on prices.
Haggle.Nothing: Haggling at {shop}: the merchant won't budge (DC {dc}).

Exchange.Title: Exchange
Exchange.NotReady: The GM hasn't created the world economy yet.
Exchange.SetupText: Regions produce and consume goods, merchants carry them along routes, and prices follow supply and demand, day after day. Start from the sample world (four regions, eight goods, four factions) or an empty one.
Exchange.NoRegions: No regions: add some in the world editor.
Exchange.LoanTerms: {rate}% interest every {days} days · cap {max}. The bank (the GM) accepts or refuses.
Exchange.NoShares: No shares yet: buy some in the Factions tab.
Exchange.MoneyLater: The chart will appear after a few days.

World.Title: World editor
World.NotReady: Create the economy from the Exchange first.
World.Name: Name
World.SpoilHint: Share of the stock lost each day (rot, theft…). Keeps stocks reasonable.
World.GoodsHint: Goods traded across the world. The base price is the price on a well-supplied market.
World.TaxHint: Added to every price in the region.
World.ProsperityHint: 1 = normal. Rises when people are well fed and supplied, drops during shortages; it drives production and demand.
World.TargetHint: Below it, the price rises; above it, the price drops.
World.RoutesHint: Merchants buy where it's cheap and sell where it's dear, as long as the gap covers transport.
World.CostHint: Transport cost, in % of the base price per day of travel.
World.CapacityHint: Maximum units carried per day, per good.
World.RiskHint: Risk premium (bandits, sea…) added to the cost.
World.TreasuryHint: The faction's money: its share price follows its value per share.
World.PriceHint: The price then moves each day toward book value × confidence.
World.DividendHint: % of the share price paid to shareholders each period.
World.UpkeepHint: Daily expenses on top of proportional costs.
World.FactionGoodsHint: The faction earns from the production and trade of these goods in its region (none checked = all).
World.AutoHint: Each day passing in Foundry's calendar advances the economy. Unchecked: only with the +1 / +7 days buttons.

Set.elasticityHint: Strength of the stock's effect on price.
Set.coverDaysHint: Normal stock = this many days of needs.
Set.minFactorHint: Minimum price, as a multiple of the base price.
Set.maxFactorHint: Maximum price, as a multiple of the base price.
Set.tradeIntensityHint: Multiplies the volumes carried by merchants.
Set.volatilityHint: Daily noise on production and share prices (0.03 = 3%).
Set.spreadHint: Gap between share buy and sell prices (0.01 = 1%).
Set.dividendDaysHint: How often dividends are paid, in days.

World.ResetHint: Replaces the whole economic world (goods, regions, factions, history). Held shares are lost.
World.ResetConfirm: Replace the whole world economy? This cannot be undone.
